items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I did a movie... of Sidney Potier and Harry Belafonte... Benny wrote the whole score for this movie and they threw it out. The Poitier and Belafonte didn't want it.

ctx.x: Yeah, but this particular date Flip brought me a Christmas present, and it was a picture, an old picture of Les Young, Prez and myself, playing, just the two of us. And it was just the greatest thing he could have done. He said, well John, I knew you were going to be on the date so I brought this from Florida just to give you because I knew you'd like to have it. And I have it. I had it framed, it's just a marvelous thing.

But I think I told you I did some other -- I've done so many things with Benny recently. I did a movie, as a matter of fact I saw the movie last night, and -- of Sidney Potier and Harry Belafonte, 'Buck and the Preacher.' Benny wrote the whole score for this movie and they threw it out. The Poitier and Belafonte didn't want it. They wanted -- well it was a good score but they wanted something more earthy. They had -- so they got about six or seven guitars, some harmonicas, and drums and let's see, and what do you…
